title: dioscorea nepalensis
intro: Dioscorea nepalensis, commonly known as Nepal yam or Nepal mountain yam, is a type of vining plant native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dioscorea nepalensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-diabetic and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
